description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This pivotal role involves overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a supportive and efficient work environment. You will be instrumental in maintaining regulatory compliance and driving continuous quality improvement initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate leader to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents and staff. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 for this full-time position. Join a team committed to excellence and providing outstanding care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
Ability to manage and mentor a diverse nursing team
